agents.role: Keeps the precinct board current: unit status and availability as dispatch reports and scribe entries arrive.
Runs roll call against the roster and tracks missed checks and unit status changes.
Keeps the incident timeline and the verified record, and flags gaps in the record while they can still be corrected.
The only agent in this pack that may post across worlds. Sends road closure and scene safety summaries (never case details) to fire and EMS worlds, and receives their incident summaries.

alerts.carries: The unit id and the missed check time. Local only.
The unit id and minutes since last confirmed contact. A supervisor decides what happens next; the pack never escalates on its own.
The roster entry id and tour. Local only; the roster itself never leaves the precinct system.
The incident id and which expected record entries are missing. Record contents never ride the line.

receives.carries: Incident id, incident type, and casualty counts by severity. Counts only, no names.
Transport counts and destination hospitals for people moved from a shared scene. Counts only.
Emergency department diversion state changes that affect where a scene clears to. States only.

sends.carries: Affected road segments, closure state, and an estimated duration. Geography and state only, no case information.
Affected road segments, closure state, and an estimated duration. Geography and state only, no case information.
Perimeter state and hazards relevant to other responders at a shared scene, summarized. No case information.

firstboot.label: Unit roster: units and their assignments for this installation
Tour or shift schedule used by roll call
Unit status check interval in minutes
Command or admin contact for this installation

bus_summary: Road closure segments and states for responder routing
Scene perimeter and hazard summaries for shared incidents
Incident id and incident type on shared incidents
local_only: Case records and the verified incident record contents
Unit assignments tied to named officers
Anything identifying a victim, suspect, or witness

summary: Precinct state and verified record pack: unit status and availability, roll call against the roster, and the incident timeline kept as a verified record. Police records law applies to everything local: records stay in the precinct system, and only responder-safety summaries cross the bus. SPEC ONLY: this is a pack definition, not a running police system.

urgency.meaning: A unit unresponsive past its threshold. Preempts everything else on the bus.
Missed unit checks and scene safety changes at a live incident.
Board state, roll-call results, and record completeness notes.
Sealed incident record and end-of-tour summary.

watchers.watches: Precinct board state: which units are available, assigned, on a scene, or out of service, kept current as status reports arrive.
Roll call and roster state: who is on tour, which units checked in, and which checks are missed.
The incident timeline and verified record: calls, assignments, arrivals, and clearances in order, with gaps flagged while they can still be corrected.
